semantics.how: Buckets ids by rank and runs alternating barycentre sweeps down and up for a few passes, breaking ties by input order
semantics.what: Groups ids into rank rows and reduces crossings
semantics.why: Fewer crossings with a deterministic tiebreak

semantics.how: For each row sorts ids by the mean index of their neighbours in the adjacent row
semantics.what: Reorders rows by neighbour barycentres in one direction
semantics.why: One pass of barycentre crossing reduction
